name: Harvest Glow Lipstick
description: A sunset-toned lipstick with a creamy matte finish designed to add earthy warmth without looking too bright.
short_description: A warm brick-orange lipstick for grounded autumn looks.
why_it_matches_template: This earthy shade mirrors warm undertones and muted depth, making it ideal when you want definition without harsh contrast.

name: Cinnamon Dusk Lipstick
description: A rich terracotta lipstick that adds warmth and definition while staying wearable across soft and warm palettes.
short_description: A satin terracotta lipstick with balanced warmth.
why_it_matches_template: The terracotta base works especially well for warm profiles that need a little more clarity than a fully muted lip.

name: Spiced Fig Lipstick
description: A warm earthy plum lipstick with a soft satin finish that adds depth while preserving a gentle overall harmony.
short_description: A muted plum lip shade with soft warmth.
why_it_matches_template: This tone is especially useful when your palette needs depth, but blackened berry shades would feel too cool or severe.

name: Amber Peach Blush
description: A warm peach blush that gives cheeks a sun-kissed flush while staying soft and bright on lighter warm complexions.
short_description: A peach-coral blush for fresh warm looks.
why_it_matches_template: The coral-peach balance gives warmth and lift without pulling too orange or too pink on spring-friendly profiles.

name: Maple Sugar Blush
description: A muted apricot powder blush designed for soft, healthy warmth that blends naturally into understated seasonal palettes.
short_description: A muted apricot blush with soft warmth.
why_it_matches_template: The toned-down apricot keeps the face lively while staying in harmony with muted, lower-contrast coloring.

name: Terracotta Bloom Blush Stick
description: A creamy stick blush in rich copper tones for users who want sculpted warmth and a more dimensional cheek color.
short_description: A rich copper blush stick for deeper warm palettes.
why_it_matches_template: It suits warmer profiles that can handle extra depth and want a cheek color that reads more bronzed than pink.

name: Autumn Earth Eyeshadow Quad
shade: Olive Green, Bronze, Caramel, Soft Brown
description: A curated quad of grounded earthy tones for warm, soft eye looks with enough variation for day or evening wear.
short_description: A balanced earthy quad for warm muted eyes.
why_it_matches_template: The palette offers warmth and structure without icy shimmer, which helps softer autumn profiles stay polished and cohesive.

name: Spice Lane Single Eyeshadow
description: A copper shimmer that adds warm reflective depth and works well when a look needs more brightness than matte neutrals provide.
short_description: A warm copper shimmer for brightening the eye.
why_it_matches_template: This is a strong match for warm palettes that benefit from glow and a little more clarity around the eyes.

name: Wood Ember Matte Eyeshadow
description: A smooth matte chestnut shadow for soft definition, especially useful when deeper profiles need structure without full black.
short_description: A matte chestnut shadow for grounded depth.
why_it_matches_template: The chestnut tone adds definition in a way that feels rich and earthy instead of stark, making it versatile for deeper palettes.
